content.text:
The robot followed the corridor to the green panel and stopped about 0.74 m in front of it, according to the sonar. I then called rest, and the robot is now crouched with its motors off.

The corridor made two left turns on the way. I got stopped by collision protection near the walls a few times, and sidestepping away from the wall fixed each one. The robot didn't fall.
